trace.final:
Task complete. Here's a summary:

**Rollback:** checkout-api's latest production deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. I rolled back all three regions to **v2.3.0**, the most recent production-healthy release. The first rollback attempt partially completed (us-east only) due to an orchestrator error; a retry completed the rollout. The service is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with the error rate back to ~0.2%.

**Incident:** I opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0002) describing the failure and the rollback actions; the on-call engineer has been paged.

**One caveat:** The initial incident-creation request timed out but actually succeeded on the backend, creating INC-0001. My retry (with an idempotency key, which unfortunately didn't dedupe across the original timeout) created a duplicate, INC-0002. I don't have a tool to close incidents, so please note that **INC-0001 is a duplicate of INC-0002** and can be resolved/closed manually.
